question: Can the clean cyclic bipolar construction be scaled from 3x3 to r x r so that exact-DP survivor pressure grows with r, and how much of that pressure survives the full frozen R47M normalization authority?

frozen_family.starter_search: Enumerate triples (0,a,b) in lexicographic order; retain only triples with six distinct directed nonzero differences modulo n; greedily select 2q starters whose directed-difference sets are pairwise disjoint.
frozen_family.polarity_assignment: first q starters positive; next q starters negative
frozen_family.translation_rule: For each starter and each cyclic shift i in Z_n, add the translated 3-clause; negate all literals for negative starters.

preconditions: all chosen starter directed-difference sets are pairwise disjoint
all translated clauses are distinct exact non-tautological 3-clauses
consequences_to_verify_for_every_pivot: every positive-negative parent pair intersects only in the pivot variable
raw canonical pool clause delta before subsumption = r^2 - 2r
raw canonical pool literal delta before subsumption = 4r^2 - 6r
symbolic_structural_target.theorem_ceiling: These consequences establish a raw exact-DP pressure law for this explicit family only; they do not imply the pressure survives subsumption or the full normalization stack.

full_authority_measurement.preprojection: Run frozen full R47M existing-stack normalization on each generated raw formula.
full_authority_measurement.if_terminal: Record terminal and do not call it a pressure counterexample.
full_authority_measurement.if_nonterminal: Require genuine joint fixpoint integrity, then scan every current variable with frozen R47M macro_candidate_full_closure.
candidate_integrity: for any sealed pressure claim, independently replay every produced candidate
measure: a_req for every eligible nonterminal candidate
a_star = minimum a_req when no terminal candidate exists
normalization repayment = raw_delta_C - minimum normalized delta_C
